false_sbo_passes.finding: All 730 gene annotations are empty. The reported pass is a false pass caused by the inverted assertion.

All 721 detected pure metabolic reactions lack the exact expected term. 668 have no SBO and 53 have generic SBO:0000375. The pass is false; the count includes both absent and insufficiently specific terms.

All 122 detected transport reactions lack an accepted transport term. 77 have no SBO and 45 have generic SBO:0000375. The pass is false. The message also incorrectly labels transport reactions as metabolic/biochemical.
All 730 genes lack SBO:0000243. The pass is false; this does not imply the model has no genes or GPR rules.
All 12 detected demands lack SBO:0000628 and have no SBO. Reported pass is false. The first docstring line wrongly says SBO:0000627, but code uses 0000628; the message also wrongly says genes.
The one detected sink, SK_cyan_c, has no SBO:0000632 or other SBO. Reported pass is false. The message wrongly says genes.

supplemental_findings.scope: Six false passes are additional interpretation limits outside the requested 80-failed/8-skipped set.

empty_inchi.parser: COBRApy discards empty URI resources; passing inchi syntax check assesses only surviving values.

regex_caveats: Annotation tests use local regular expressions and never dereference external identifiers; syntax is not chemical, taxonomic or directional identity.
Current WP_ RefSeq protein accessions are omitted from MEMOTE 0.17.0 refseq prefix list; do not degrade valid mappings to fit that list.
The HMDB regex accepts exactly five digits, but current official HMDB documentation specifies seven-digit identifiers (https://www.hmdb.ca/about); a valid modernization could create a false failure.
The Reactome regex permits a hyphenated version suffix on R-species identifiers whereas official stable identifiers document dotted versions.
EC/BRENDA regex alternatives are not fully anchored as a group and pattern.match may accept some trailing junk; BRENDA provisional B-numbers are rejected despite official support.
The uniprot character classes contain commas/spaces and alternative anchoring is uneven; no existing gene IDs are tested here, because all gene annotation dictionaries are empty.

source_semantics.reaction_wrong_ids_denominator: all 913 reactions, unlike metabolite_wrong_ids which divides by annotations present

supplemental_findings.cross_format_sbo: The source JSON stores ontology annotations under uppercase SBO; the audited SBML is loaded by COBRApy with lowercase sbo and contains 21 annotated species plus 141 annotated reactions. Checking raw JSON for lowercase sbo would falsely report zero. Audit interpretations here use the SBML path recorded by run-metadata.
supplemental_findings.guanine_xanthine: Original JSON and raw SBML give gua_c/gua_p a C5H5N5O InChI and xan_c/xan_p a different C5H4N4O2 InChI. Their structures are distinct; root audit confirms XANt2pp instead contains guanine metabolites, an equation error rather than an InChI collision.
